tagline.en: Depth Anything 3 metric prior — the latest generation, delivering metric monocular depth from a single image.
tagline.zh: Depth Anything 3 度量先验——最新一代,从单张图像给出度量单目深度。

en: Depth Anything 3 Metric Prior is the newest generation of the Depth Anything family, from ByteDance Seed. Where the earlier versions focused on relative depth, this metric variant predicts depth in real-world units from a single image.

In WorldFoundry it is packaged as an independent depth prior built around the DA3METRIC-LARGE checkpoint, with its own runtime configuration kept separate from other pipelines. That makes it a clean, self-contained source of metric geometry.
It runs through the shared geometry-prior pipeline: feed it an image and it returns a metric depth estimate that downstream 3D and 4D stages can consume.
zh: Depth Anything 3 Metric Prior 是 Depth Anything 家族的最新一代,来自 ByteDance Seed。相较早期版本聚焦相对深度,这一度量变体能从单张图像预测以真实世界单位表示的深度。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它被封装为围绕 DA3METRIC-LARGE checkpoint 构建的独立深度先验,并拥有与其他 pipeline 分离的独立运行时配置。这使它成为干净、自成一体的度量几何来源。
它通过共享的 geometry-prior pipeline 运行:给它一张图像,它就会返回可供下游 3D、4D 环节使用的度量深度估计。

whenToUse.en: Use this when you want the latest Depth Anything generation and need metric depth from single images — real-world-scaled geometry to feed a 3D/4D workflow.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想使用最新一代 Depth Anything、并需要从单张图像获得度量深度时使用它——为 3D/4D 工作流提供以真实尺度表示的几何。

notFor.en: It's a geometry prior that outputs depth, not a full reconstruction pipeline, and it targets standard images rather than 360° panoramas.
notFor.zh: 它是输出深度的几何先验,而非完整重建 pipeline,并且面向标准图像而非 360° 全景。

zh: 最新一代 Depth Anything 3 先验
预测度量(真实尺度)单目深度
围绕 DA3METRIC-LARGE checkpoint 构建
通过 geometry-prior pipeline 对外提供
